item.title: After Israel's invasion, many in southern Lebanon worry they'll never go home
item.summary: Israel says it's creating a "security zone" inside Lebanon, where homes will be demolished, and residents won't be allowed to return home until people in northern Israel feel safe.

item.title: Trump will address the nation after saying the U.S. may leave the Iran war within weeks
item.summary: President Trump is set to address the nation on the Iran war Wednesday night and provide an "important update," White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said.

item.title: WATCH LIVE: NASA's Artemis II astronauts launch to the moon
item.summary: NASA's Artemis II mission aims to send four astronauts around the moon on a roughly 10-day journey that could help pave the way toward a future lunar landing.

item.title: A propaganda war on the National Mall pits Trump against satirical statues and posters
item.summary: The Trump administration and its critics are waging a war of images on the National Mall like none before. The president's face stares down from federal buildings while statues and posters mock him below.

item.title: Greetings from London, where a big COVID memorial holds vigil over the halls of power
item.summary: Britain's 1,640-foot-long National Covid Memorial Wall stretches along the River Thames, with over a quarter million hearts representing the lives lost during the pandemic — across from Parliament.

item.title: From scrappy startup to tech giant, Apple celebrates its 50th year
item.summary: Countercultural mythmaking and global corporate dominance have helped the tech corporation sail through criticism.

item.title: 4 takeaways from the U.S. men's national soccer team's World Cup tune-up games
item.summary: The two losses — 5-2 to Belgium and 2-0 to Portugal — were a wakeup call for the USMNT and the team's ambitions for this summer's World Cup. But the Americans said they welcomed the lessons learned.

item.title: Homesick in a foreign country, a teenager meets a lifelong friend
item.summary: Holly Deiaco-Smith was feeling homesick while studying abroad in France when she was 19 years old. An encounter at the post office changed everything and led to a decades-long friendship.

item.title: Supreme Court considers a historic case about who is — and isn't — born a citizen
item.summary: At issue is President Trump's challenge to a constitutional provision that has long been interpreted to guarantee American citizenship to every child born in the United States.

item.title: Federal judge rules DHS illegally stripped immigration status from thousands who entered through CBP One App
item.summary: Tuesday's ruling reinstates the immigration status of those who came via CBP One and whose status was terminated.
